title: Beech Fork Campground Electrical
overview: New power distribution for the 39 campsites at Beech Fork's Moxley Branch — service equipment, distribution panels, and RV-ready pedestals, maximizing larger 50-amp sites within budget. With the campground sitting ~30 ft below the 100-year floodplain and overhead service prohibited, MEI designed a tower to raise the service disconnect above the floodplain, with shunt-trip capability for emergency remote shutdown.
